title: the WSG going without food and water
audit_label: R462 WSG food and water pin audit
audit_comment: The Table 28 ladder and the Table 29 grid cell by cell, the 12-hour check cadence with the +1/+2 modifier ladders, the water tolerance modifier set with the floor, the animal incapacitation and recovery rules, the ration arithmetic and the daily water requirement arithmetic - every cell, const, bool and chain limit verified against the model.

banner.title: R462: the WSG FOOD AND WATER chapter opener - going without food (Table 28), going without water, the effects on animals, the minimum daily requirement of food and the minimum daily requirement of water (Table 29), printed pp. 50-53.
banner.provenance: Ground truth three-way: the user Drive PDF OCR (Wilderness Survival Guide.pdf pp. 50-53) vs the archive djvu word layer vs IIIF eye-reads of leaves 0050-0053 - Table 28 settled on the image (the djvu garbles the 4/5/6/7/8/10 ladder), the +2/+4 example modifiers, the 1.5-times animal multiple, the cumulative -4 recovery modifier and the water encumbrance sentence eye-read; Table 29 clean in both text layers.
banner.sentinel: All fractions pinned cross-multiplied (division-free); the book examples (Str 12 + Con 14 = 26, the +2/+4 checks, the ration packs, the 56-pint cubic foot) are audit examples.

consts.name: wnfCheckEveryHours
consts.comment: past tolerance: a Str or Con check (higher score) every 12 hours to remain unaffected

consts.name: wnfCheckIncumPerCheck
consts.comment: every check after the first: a cumulative +1 on the die roll (+1 second, +2 third, and so on)

consts.name: wnfWeakCheckIncum
consts.comment: after the first failed check: subsequent checks at a cumulative +2 on the die roll

consts.name: wnfWeakAtkPenaltyFirstDay
consts.comment: weakened: -1 on attack rolls and dodging or reaction saving throws the first day

consts.name: wnfWeakPenaltyWorsenPerDay
consts.comment: while weakened the penalty worsens by -1 per day

consts.name: wnfRecoveryStepsPerDay
consts.comment: eating at least one full meal per day: the condition improves by two steps per day

consts.name: wnfIncapPenaltyFloor
consts.comment: incapacitated: accumulated penalties retained or worsened to -4 if they were not that low already

consts.name: wnfIncapRecoveryMinMeals
consts.comment: incapacitated recovers only via solid nourishment for at least two consecutive days (at least two full meals, spaced one day apart)

consts.name: wnfIncapFailedCheckIncum
consts.comment: if the incapacitated recovery check fails and he keeps eating one meal a day: subsequent daily checks at a cumulative -4 until one succeeds

consts.name: wnfIncapHpLossPerHourDie
consts.comment: incapacitated without eating within 12 hours: hit points lost at 1d6 per hour, death at zero

consts.name: wnfIncapHpRegainPerHourDie
consts.comment: nourishment while alive: hit points regained at 1d4 per hour

consts.name: wnfIncapPenaltyPerHour
consts.comment: an additional -1 on attack rolls and saving throws for each hour of hit-point loss

consts.name: wnfDistressStrenuousTurnLimit
consts.comment: distressed: no more than two turns of strenuous activity before a Con check, a fail means automatic exhaustion (not merely fatigued)

consts.name: wnfWaterBaseTolerance
consts.comment: general rule: no character goes without liquid nourishment more than three days before adverse effects

consts.name: wnfWaterModHighWaterFood
consts.comment: +2 days if food with a high water content is eaten (standard rations, green plants, raw meat, fruits, vegetables)

consts.name: wnfWaterModHeavy
consts.comment: +1 day if body weight over 200 pounds, above average weight for the race, or average weight and below average height

consts.name: wnfWaterModFemale
consts.comment: +1 day if female

consts.name: wnfWaterModNoStrenuous
consts.comment: +1 day without strenuous activity the entire period (a once-per-day very short burst allowable)

consts.name: wnfWaterModHot90
consts.comment: -1 day if the effective temperature reaches or exceeds 90 degrees even once, magical or natural

consts.name: wnfWaterModLessMeal
consts.comment: -1 day without at least one meal per day

consts.name: wnfWaterModLowStrCon
consts.comment: -1 day if strength or constitution under 8

consts.name: wnfWaterToleranceFloor
consts.comment: negative modifiers can never reduce the water tolerance level below one day

consts.name: wnfWaterNoStrenuousLossTurns
consts.comment: one turn of strenuous activity during a day loses the no-strenuous-activity benefit

consts.name: wnfAnimalHalveFactor
consts.comment: a weakened animal: movement and carrying capacity both reduced to one-half (divide by two)

consts.name: wnfAnimalHardWorkTurns
consts.comment: a weakened animal forced to work hard longer than three turns in a day: incapacitated at the end of the third turn

consts.name: wnfAnimalIncapMultNum
consts.comment: the incapacitation multiple numerator: 1.5 times the tolerance level (rounded down)

consts.name: wnfAnimalIncapMultDen
consts.comment: the incapacitation multiple denominator (3/2)

consts.name: wnfAnimalRestMinHours
consts.comment: a weakened animal fed or watered: back to full strength after 13-24 hours of rest

consts.name: wnfAnimalRestMaxHours
consts.comment: the rest window upper end (1d12 + 12)

consts.name: wnfAnimalRestDieSides
consts.comment: the recovery rest die (1d12 + 12)

consts.name: wnfAnimalRestDieBonus
consts.comment: the recovery rest die bonus

consts.name: wnfAnimalEffortDeathTurns
consts.comment: an incapacitated animal dies if forced to expend appreciable energy for as little as one turn

consts.name: wnfAnimalIncapIdleDeathDays
consts.comment: an incapacitated animal dies after one day in the condition even if unencumbered and stationary

consts.name: wnfFoodHumanMinLb
consts.comment: a human, dwarf, half-orc or half-elf needs 1-2 pounds of solid nourishment per day: the floor

consts.name: wnfFoodHumanMaxLb
consts.comment: the daily food requirement ceiling in pounds

consts.name: wnfFoodElfNum
consts.comment: an elf needs three-fourths of a human-sized ration: the numerator

consts.name: wnfFoodElfDen
consts.comment: the elf ration fraction denominator (3/4)

consts.name: wnfFoodSmallNum
consts.comment: a gnome or halfling gets along on half a human ration: the numerator

consts.name: wnfFoodSmallDen
consts.comment: the small race fraction (1/2)

consts.name: wnfRationWeekDays
consts.comment: a ration pack feeds one human for one week (seven days)

consts.name: wnfStdRationEncGp
consts.comment: the standard rations pack encumbrance value in gold pieces

consts.name: wnfStdRationWeightLb
consts.comment: the standard rations pack actual weight in pounds (140 gp)

consts.name: wnfStdRationBulkGp
consts.comment: the standard rations pack bulk accounts for the other 60 gp

consts.name: wnfStdRationDailyLb
consts.comment: the minimum daily requirement of standard rations: two pounds

consts.name: wnfIronRationEncGp
consts.comment: the iron rations pack encumbrance value

consts.name: wnfIronRationBulkGp
consts.comment: the iron rations bulk: perhaps as little as 5 gp

consts.name: wnfIronRationWeightLb
consts.comment: the iron rations actual weight: 70 gp = 7 pounds

consts.name: wnfIronRationDailyLb
consts.comment: the minimum daily requirement of iron rations: one pound

consts.name: wnfMeatVegNourishRatio
consts.comment: one pound of meat provides the nourishment of two pounds of vegetables

consts.name: wnfMealsPerDayMin
consts.comment: a character should eat at least twice a day (after a night rest, at the end of the day)

consts.name: wnfMissedMealToHitMod
consts.comment: a missed meal: the DM may assign -1 "to hit"

consts.name: wnfMissedMealCheckMod
consts.comment: a missed meal: +1 on Strength or Constitution checks, until the next nourishment

consts.name: wnfHalfRationCheatNum
consts.comment: cheating by half the recommended amount: the numerator (1/2)

consts.name: wnfHalfRationCheatDen
consts.comment: the cheat fraction denominator

consts.name: wnfHalfRationDaysNum
consts.comment: half rations sustain normal activity for 1.5 times the tolerance level rounded down: the numerator

consts.name: wnfHalfRationDaysDen
consts.comment: the half-ration days multiple denominator (3/2)

consts.name: wnfBandCount
consts.comment: the Table 28 band count (six combined Str+Con bands)

consts.name: wnfTempBandCount
consts.comment: the Table 29 temperature band count (below 50, 50-70, 71-90, above 90)

consts.name: wnfElfWaterRedNum
consts.comment: elves need one-fourth less water: the numerator

consts.name: wnfElfWaterRedDen
consts.comment: the elf water reduction fraction (1/4, rounded up to the nearest half-pint)

consts.name: wnfDemiWaterRedNum
consts.comment: dwarves, gnomes and halflings need one-third less water: the numerator

consts.name: wnfDemiWaterRedDen
consts.comment: the demihuman water reduction fraction (1/3, rounded up to the nearest pint or half-pint)

consts.name: wnfHighWaterFoodMinNum
consts.comment: high-water-content food covers one-fourth to one-third of the daily water requirement: the lower numerator

consts.name: wnfHighWaterFoodMinDen
consts.comment: the lower fraction denominator (1/4)

consts.name: wnfHighWaterFoodMaxNum
consts.comment: the upper fraction numerator

consts.name: wnfHighWaterFoodMaxDen
consts.comment: the upper fraction denominator (1/3)

consts.name: wnfInactHourLimit
consts.comment: inactive: one hour or less of significant physical activity in the day

consts.name: wnfLightHourOver
consts.comment: light activity: more than one hour on non-sedentary pursuits

consts.name: wnfModerateHourOver
consts.comment: moderate activity: more than two hours

consts.name: wnfHeavyHourOver
consts.comment: heavy activity: more than four hours

consts.name: wnfCubicFootGallons
consts.comment: one cubic foot of water contains seven gallons

consts.name: wnfGallonPints
consts.comment: there are eight pints in a gallon

consts.name: wnfWaterEncPerGallon
consts.comment: water has an encumbrance value of 50 gp per gallon

consts.name: wnfContainerEncPerGallons
consts.comment: plus an extra 50 gp for every three gallons transported in a single container

consts.name: wnfContainerEncGp
consts.comment: the per-container-bulk charge in gold pieces

consts.name: wnfWaterskinGallons
consts.comment: a typical waterskin holds one gallon

bools.name: wnfFoodToleranceRequiresWater
bools.comment: no ill effects from going without food only with an adequate supply of drinking water

bools.name: wnfWaterAnyDrinkableLiquid
bools.comment: "water" is any liquid swallowed without harmful effects - the same benefit as pure water

bools.name: wnfStandardRationsHighWater
bools.comment: standard rations have a high water content

bools.name: wnfIronRationsHighWater
bools.comment: iron rations do NOT have a high water content

bools.name: wnfGreenPlantsRawMeatHighWater
bools.comment: green plants, raw meat, fruits and vegetables have a high water content

bools.name: wnfTreeBarkHighWater
bools.comment: tree bark is edible but has no high water content, nor dried or cooked meat, nor bread

bools.name: wnfWaterModsCumulative
bools.comment: the water tolerance modifiers are all cumulative

bools.name: wnfWaterDeprivationUsesFoodConditions
bools.comment: weakened, distressed and incapacitated from lack of water follow the going-without-food conditions and transitions

bools.name: wnfTotalDeprivationIncapOnFail
bools.comment: without food AND water: after the water tolerance onset, a failed check means immediate incapacitation

bools.name: wnfDistressFailExhaustedNotFatigued
bools.comment: a distressed character failing the strenuous Con check becomes automatically exhausted, not merely fatigued

bools.name: wnfIncapNoVoluntaryActivity
bools.comment: an incapacitated character is incapable of any voluntary physical activity

bools.name: wnfAnimalMoveCarryHalved
bools.comment: a weakened animal has movement and carrying capacity halved

bools.name: wnfOvereatingNoBenefit
bools.comment: overeating offers no significant benefit in game terms

bools.name: wnfHalfRationFullMealRecovers
bools.comment: one full ration on any single day offsets the half-ration weakness

bools.name: wnfHalfRationIndefiniteIfIdle
bools.comment: without significant physical activity a character subsists on half rations indefinitely

bools.name: wnfMissedMealBelowAvgSusceptible
bools.comment: below-average strength or constitution is especially susceptible to a missed meal

bools.name: wnfNotEnoughWaterAsBadAsNone
bools.comment: not enough water is just as bad as none: less than a full ration triggers the tolerance clock

bools.name: wnfAnimalsRecoverQuickly
bools.comment: animals recover rather quickly from food or water deprivation

chains.name: wnfBandFor
chains.comment: the combined Str+Con band: 15 or less 0, 16-19 1, 20-24 2, 25-30 3, 31-35 4, 36 or more 5

chains.name: wnfTempBandFor
chains.comment: the effective temperature band: below 50 0, 50-70 1, 71-90 2, above 90 3

col_comments: the Table 29 inactive pints per temperature band
tables.audit_comment: the Table 29 pint grid (rows: below 50, 50-70, 71-90, above 90)

examples.note: the book example: Str 12 + Con 14 = 26 lands in band 3 with a seven-day tolerance
the example check at +2 fails a Con 14 on 13 or higher
the weakened example check at +4 fails on 11 or higher (+2 ladder plus the +2 weakened shift)
the elf three-fourths ration: 2 lb human -> 1.5 lb elf, cross-multiplied
the gnome or halfling half ration, cross-multiplied
the standard rations pack: 14 lb over a week is 2 lb per day
the iron rations pack: 7 lb over a week is 1 lb per day
the half-ration cheat: 1.5 times the tolerance, cross-multiplied (tolerance 5 -> 7 days)
the animal incapacitation multiple: 1.5 times tolerance rounded down (tolerance 4 -> 6 days)
the animal recovery rest: 1d12 + 12 spans 13-24 hours
the recovery rest floor: the die minimum plus one is 13 hours
a cubic foot of create water: 7 gallons x 8 pints = 56 pints
the Table 29 corner: heavy activity above 90 costs 16 pints
